# lostcoords-ui

Rails rendering helpers with semantic HTML, native attributes and browser interactions.

Install and styling: https://ui.lostcoords.com/installation.html
Theming: https://ui.lostcoords.com/theming.html
API JSON: https://ui.lostcoords.com/api.json

Tailwind CSS v4 is required. Install the gem once; the Rails engine exposes all ui_* helpers without per-component imports.
The engine includes a default light and dark theme. Override CSS variables only as needed. Use class: to merge Tailwind utilities, data: and aria: for native attributes. Block helpers capture Rails ERB.
ui_button_to keeps Rails form, method and CSRF semantics. Each host application's lockfile pins its version.

## ui_stack

```ruby
ui_stack(gap: :content, **attributes, &block)
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { ui_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline class: "flex-nowrap justify-between" do %>
        <%= ui_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= ui_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline do %>
        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
        <%= ui_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Responsive containers: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_container do %>
  <%= ui_stack gap: :section do %>
    <%= ui_heading "Plan your next trip", level: 2, size: :page %>
    <div class="grid min-w-0 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
      <%= ui_section title: "Travel details", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_stack do %>
            <%= ui_text "Kyoto weekend", size: :body %>
            <%= ui_text "Keep shared costs and travel notes together.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
            <%= ui_inline do %>
              <%= ui_button "Invite friends", size: :sm %>
              <%= ui_button "View itinerary", variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
            <% end %>
          <% end %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
      <%= ui_section title: "Shared costs", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_text "No expenses yet", size: :body %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    </div>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

## ui_inline

```ruby
ui_inline(gap: :related, **attributes, &block)
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { ui_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline class: "flex-nowrap justify-between" do %>
        <%= ui_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= ui_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline do %>
        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
        <%= ui_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Responsive containers: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_container do %>
  <%= ui_stack gap: :section do %>
    <%= ui_heading "Plan your next trip", level: 2, size: :page %>
    <div class="grid min-w-0 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
      <%= ui_section title: "Travel details", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_stack do %>
            <%= ui_text "Kyoto weekend", size: :body %>
            <%= ui_text "Keep shared costs and travel notes together.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
            <%= ui_inline do %>
              <%= ui_button "Invite friends", size: :sm %>
              <%= ui_button "View itinerary", variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
            <% end %>
          <% end %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
      <%= ui_section title: "Shared costs", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_text "No expenses yet", size: :body %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    </div>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

```erb
    <% end %>

    <% end %>
  <% end %>
```

```erb
      <%= ui_inline do %>
        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
        <%= ui_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
```

## ui_button

```ruby
ui_button(content = nil, variant: :primary, size: :base, icon: nil, icon_position: :start, **attributes, &block)
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { ui_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline class: "flex-nowrap justify-between" do %>
        <%= ui_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= ui_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline do %>
        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
        <%= ui_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Responsive containers: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_container do %>
  <%= ui_stack gap: :section do %>
    <%= ui_heading "Plan your next trip", level: 2, size: :page %>
    <div class="grid min-w-0 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
      <%= ui_section title: "Travel details", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_stack do %>
            <%= ui_text "Kyoto weekend", size: :body %>
            <%= ui_text "Keep shared costs and travel notes together.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
            <%= ui_inline do %>
              <%= ui_button "Invite friends", size: :sm %>
              <%= ui_button "View itinerary", variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
            <% end %>
          <% end %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
      <%= ui_section title: "Shared costs", level: 3 do %>
        <%= ui_card do %>
          <%= ui_text "No expenses yet", size: :body %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    </div>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Reading content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_prose do %>
  <h2>Make room for the trip</h2>
  <p>A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.</p>
  <p>Start with <strong>one clear decision</strong>, then <a href="#reading-next">choose what comes next</a>.</p>
  <ul>
    <li>Choose a place to stay.</li>
    <li>Set aside time for a slow morning.</li>
    <li>Leave an afternoon open.</li>
  </ul>
  <blockquote><p>The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.</p></blockquote>
  <h3 id="reading-next">Ready to begin?</h3>
  <p>Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.</p>
  <div class="not-prose mt-5">
    <%= ui_button "Create a plan" %>
  </div>
<% end %>
```

Default: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button "Create project" %>
```

Variants: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button "Primary" %>
<%= ui_button "Secondary", variant: :secondary %>
<%= ui_button "Ghost", variant: :ghost %>
<%= ui_button "Delete", variant: :destructive %>
```

Sizes: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button "Small", size: :sm %>
<%= ui_button "Default" %>
<%= ui_button "Large", size: :lg %>
```

With an icon: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button "Create project", icon: "plus" %>
<%= ui_button "Continue", icon: "arrow-right", icon_position: :end, variant: :secondary %>
```

Custom icons and content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button variant: :secondary do %>
  <%= heroicon "arrow-down-tray", options: {
    "aria-hidden": true,
    "data-icon": "inline-start"
  } %>
  Download report
<% end %>

<%= ui_button disabled: true, aria: { busy: true } do %>
  <%= ui_spinner size: :sm, label: nil,
      data: { icon: "inline-start" } %>
  Loading report…
<% end %>
```

Loading: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button disabled: true, aria: { busy: true } do %>
  <%= ui_spinner size: :sm, label: nil, data: { icon: "inline-start" } %>
  Saving…
<% end %>
```

Disabled: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button "Unavailable", disabled: true %>
```

Empty state: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/empty_state.html

```erb
<%= ui_form_card padding: :empty, class: "w-full" do %>
  <%= ui_empty_state do %>
    <%= ui_medallion icon: "folder-plus" %>
    <h3 class="font-semibold">No projects yet</h3>
    <p class="text-sm text-ink-2">Create a project to get started.</p>
    <%= ui_button "Create project" %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Form actions: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/field.html

```erb
<%= ui_form_actions do %>
  <%= ui_button "Cancel", variant: :ghost %>
  <%= ui_button "Save changes", type: :submit %>
<% end %>
```

Form values and reset: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/segmented.html

```erb
<form class="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
  <%= ui_segmented label: "Billing", name: "billing", value: "monthly" do %>
    <%= ui_segmented_tab "Monthly", value: "monthly", selected: true %>
    <%= ui_segmented_tab "Annual", value: "annual" %>
    <%= ui_segmented_tab "Custom", value: "custom", disabled: true %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_button "Reset", type: :reset, variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
</form>
```

Modal: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html

```erb
<%= ui_dialog id: "my-component-dialog", title: "Create project", trigger: "New project" do %>
  <form method="dialog" class="flex flex-col gap-5">
  <%= ui_field label: "Project name", id: "my-component-dialog-name" do |field| %>
    <%= ui_input name: "project[name]", **field %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_form_actions do %>
    <%= ui_button "Create project", type: :submit %>
  <% end %>
  </form>
<% end %>
```

## ui_button_link_to

```ruby
ui_button_link_to(content = nil, url = nil, variant: :primary, size: :base, icon: nil, icon_position: :start, **attributes, &block)
```

As a link: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button_link_to "Browse components", "/components/button.html", variant: :secondary %>
```

## ui_button_to

```ruby
ui_button_to(content = nil, url = nil, variant: :primary, size: :base, icon: nil, icon_position: :start, **attributes, &block)
```

HTTP actions: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= ui_button_to "Archive project", "/projects/42", method: :delete, variant: :destructive, form: { data: { turbo_confirm: "Archive this project?" } } %>
```

## ui_icon_button

```ruby
ui_icon_button(label, icon:, size: :base, shape: :circle, **attributes)
```

Shapes and sizes: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/icon_button.html

```erb
<%= ui_icon_button "Add project", icon: "plus" %>
<%= ui_icon_button "Settings", icon: "cog-6-tooth", shape: :square %>
<%= ui_icon_button "Search", icon: "magnifying-glass", size: :sm %>
<%= ui_icon_button "Close", icon: "x-mark", size: :lg %>
```

## ui_avatar

```ruby
ui_avatar(content = nil, src: nil, alt: nil, size: :base, ink: false, linked: false, **attributes, &block)
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { ui_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline class: "flex-nowrap justify-between" do %>
        <%= ui_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= ui_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= ui_card do %>
      <%= ui_inline do %>
        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
        <%= ui_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Initials and images: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/avatar.html

```erb
<%= ui_avatar "AL", aria: { label: "Alex Lee" } %>
<%= ui_avatar "SK", size: :lg, ink: true, aria: { label: "Sam Kim" } %>
```

A group of people: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/avatar_stack.html

```erb
<%= ui_avatar_stack aria: { label: "Alex, Sam and Jamie" } do %>
  <%= ui_avatar "AL" %>
  <%= ui_avatar "SK" %>
  <%= ui_avatar "JR" %>
<% end %>
```

```erb
  <% end %>
```

```erb
    <%= ui_card do %>

        <%= ui_avatar "AK", class: "bg-sky" %>
```

Default: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/card.html

```erb
<%= ui_card class: "w-full" do %>
  <h3 class="font-semibold">Project notes</h3>
  <p class="text-sm text-ink-2">Keep related content together.</p>
<% end %>
```

Dense: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/card.html

```erb
<%= ui_card dense: true, class: "w-full" do %>
  <p class="text-sm">A compact summary.</p>
<% end %>
```

Linked card: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/card.html

```erb
<%= ui_card href: "/components/card.html", class: "w-full" do %>
  <h3 class="font-semibold">Design system</h3>
  <p class="text-sm text-ink-2">Open the project.</p>
<% end %>
```

## ui_form_card

```ruby
ui_form_card(padding: :default, **attributes, &block)
```

Form card: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/card.html

```erb
<%= ui_form_card class: "w-full" do %>
  <%= ui_field label: "Project name", id: "my-component-name" do |field| %>
    <%= ui_input name: "project[name]", value: "Design system", **field %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Empty state: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/empty_state.html

```erb
<%= ui_form_card padding: :empty, class: "w-full" do %>

  <% end %>
```

## ui_empty_state

```ruby
ui_empty_state(**attributes, &block)
```

```erb
<%= ui_form_card padding: :empty, class: "w-full" do %>
  <%= ui_empty_state do %>
    <%= ui_medallion icon: "folder-plus" %>

<% end %>
```

## ui_prose

```ruby
ui_prose(**attributes, &block)
```

Reading content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_prose do %>
  <h2>Make room for the trip</h2>
  <p>A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.</p>
  <p>Start with <strong>one clear decision</strong>, then <a href="#reading-next">choose what comes next</a>.</p>
  <ul>
    <li>Choose a place to stay.</li>
    <li>Set aside time for a slow morning.</li>
    <li>Leave an afternoon open.</li>
  </ul>
  <blockquote><p>The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.</p></blockquote>
  <h3 id="reading-next">Ready to begin?</h3>
  <p>Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.</p>
  <div class="not-prose mt-5">
    <%= ui_button "Create a plan" %>
  </div>
<% end %>
```

Japanese reading: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= ui_prose lang: "ja" do %>
  <h2>旅の計画に、少しの余白を。</h2>
  <p>みんなで予定を考えるときは、大切なことから順番に決めていきましょう。読みやすい行間と段落の間隔が、長い文章をたどる手助けになります。</p>
  <h3>最初に決めておきたいこと</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>集合する場所と時間</li>
    <li>みんなで分ける費用</li>
    <li>自由に過ごす時間</li>
  </ul>
  <p>予定が変わったら、<a href="#reading-japanese-note">グループにひとこと</a>。少しの共有で、旅がもっと気軽になります。</p>
  <blockquote id="reading-japanese-note"><p>何もしない時間も、旅の楽しみのひとつです。</p></blockquote>
<% end %>
```

```erb

  <% end %>
```
```erb
  </form>
<% end %>
```

```erb
    </div>
```
```erb
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"

export default class extends Controller {
  connect() {
    this.scroll()
  }

  scroll() {
    this.element.toggleAttribute("data-scrolled", window.scrollY > 8)
  }
}
```

app/javascript/controllers/blocks_mobile_navigation_controller.js

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"

export default class extends Controller {
  static targets = ["link", "panel", "indicator", "status", "projects", "notes", "draft"]

  connect() {
    this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.placeIndicator())
    this.linkTargets.forEach((link) => this.resizeObserver.observe(link))
    this.onViewportResize = () => this.keyboard()
    window.visualViewport?.addEventListener("resize", this.onViewportResize)
    this.placeIndicator()
  }

  disconnect() {
    this.resizeObserver.disconnect()
    window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener("resize", this.onViewportResize)
  }

  select(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    this.show(event.currentTarget.hash.slice(1))
  }

  home(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    this.show("projects")
  }

  show(id) {
    for (const link of this.linkTargets) {
      if (link.hash === `#${id}`) link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page")
      else link.removeAttribute("aria-current")
    }
    for (const panel of this.panelTargets) panel.hidden = panel.id !== id
    this.placeIndicator()
  }

  placeIndicator() {
    const active = this.linkTargets.find((link) => link.getAttribute("aria-current") === "page")
    this.indicatorTarget.style.translate = `${active.offsetLeft}px 0`
    this.indicatorTarget.style.width = `${active.offsetWidth}px`
  }

  add({ params: { destination } }) {
    const draft = this.draftTarget.content.cloneNode(true)
    const title = destination === "projects" ? "Untitled project" : "A new thought"
    draft.querySelector("[data-draft-title]").textContent = title
    const list = destination === "projects" ? this.projectsTarget : this.notesTarget
    list.prepend(draft)
    this.show(destination)
    this.statusTarget.textContent = `${title} added. Your next idea starts here.`
  }

  keyboard() {
    const typing = document.activeElement?.matches("input, textarea, [contenteditable=true]")
    const inset = window.innerHeight - (window.visualViewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight)
    this.element.toggleAttribute("data-keyboard", typing && inset > 150)
  }
}
```

### Global search

A search trigger that expands into a focused overlay with grouped results.
https://ui.lostcoords.com/blocks/global_search.html

This example filters sample results in the browser so it also works on the static documentation site.

Replace the sample results with your own data or a Turbo Frame endpoint. Keep permissions, ranking and fetching in your application.

app/views/shared/_global_search.html.erb

```erb

    "Projects" => [
      { title: "Fieldwork", detail: "A quieter identity for an outdoor journal.", icon: "sun", meta: "Brand identity", words: "brand identity outdoor journal fieldwork" },

    ],
    "People" => [
      { title: "Alex Lee", detail: "Alex leads brand design and the Fieldwork project.", icon: "user", meta: "Designer", words: "alex lee designer fieldwork" },

    ]
  }
%>
<div class="search-example min-h-screen" data-controller="blocks-search" data-action="turbo:before-cache@document->blocks-search#reset">
  <header class="px-5 pt-5 sm:px-8">

        <span class="hidden flex-1 text-start text-sm sm:block">Search anything…</span>

      </button>
      <%= ui_avatar "AL", size: :sm, class: "bg-sky-soft text-accent", aria: { label: "Alex Lee" } %>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main id="main" class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8 px-5 py-12 sm:px-8 sm:py-16">

      <div class="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <% collections.fetch("Projects").each do |item| %>
          <%= ui_card class: "flex flex-col items-start gap-5" do %>
            <%= ui_medallion icon: item[:icon], size: :lg %>
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-1"><h3 class="font-semibold"><%= item[:title] %></h3><p class="text-sm text-ink-3"><%= item[:meta] %></p></div>
            <%= ui_button "Explore", variant: :ghost, size: :sm, icon: "arrow-up-right", icon_position: :end, data: { action: "blocks-search#explore", title: item[:title], detail: item[:detail] } %>
          <% end %>
        <% end %>
      </div>
    </section>
    <%= ui_card class: "flex flex-col gap-3", aria: { labelledby: "search-selection-heading" } do %>
      <%= ui_eyebrow "A LITTLE LESS LOOKING" %>
      <h2 id="search-selection-heading" class="text-xl font-semibold" data-blocks-search-target="selectionTitle">Find your next thought.</h2>
      <p class="max-w-xl text-sm text-ink-2" data-blocks-search-target="selectionDetail">Open search and try “Fieldwork”, “Alex”, or “references”. Use the arrow keys to move through results.</p>
    <% end %>
    <p class="sr-only" role="status" data-blocks-search-target="selectionStatus"></p>
  </main>

  <dialog class="search-example__dialog" aria-label="Search workspace" data-blocks-search-target="dialog" data-action="close->blocks-search#closed keydown->blocks-search#navigate click->blocks-search#dismiss">
    <div class="search-example__stack" data-search-dismiss>
      <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
        <label class="<%= glass_class(extra: "flex min-h-14 min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-text items-center gap-3 ps-5 pe-2 sm:min-h-16") %>" data-blocks-search-target="bar">
          <%= heroicon "magnifying-glass", options: { class: "size-6 shrink-0 text-ink-3", "aria-hidden": true } %>
          <input type="search" class="search-example__input min-w-0 flex-1 self-stretch border-0 bg-transparent text-base text-ink placeholder:text-ink-3" aria-label="Search projects, people, and notes" placeholder="Search anything…" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="search" data-blocks-search-target="input" data-action="input->blocks-search#filter compositionend->blocks-search#filter">
          <%= ui_icon_button "Clear search", icon: "x-circle", size: :sm, hidden: true, data: { blocks_search_target: "clear", action: "blocks-search#clear" } %>
          <kbd class="hidden rounded-lg bg-paper-2 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-ink-3 sm:block" aria-hidden="true">esc</kbd>
        </label>
        <%= ui_button "Cancel", variant: :ghost, size: :sm, data: { action: "blocks-search#close" } %>
      </div>
      <div class="<%= glass_class(shape: :panel, extra: "search-example__results min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-2") %>" data-blocks-search-target="results">
        <p class="px-3 pb-2 pt-3 text-xs text-ink-3" data-blocks-search-target="summary" role="status">Start with something recent</p>
        <% collections.each do |name, items| %>
          <section class="py-2" aria-label="<%= name %>" data-blocks-search-target="group">
            <h2 class="px-3 pb-2 font-mono text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-ink-3"><%= name %></h2>
            <% items.each do |item| %>
              <button type="button" class="search-example__result flex min-h-16 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-start" data-blocks-search-target="result" data-action="blocks-search#select" data-title="<%= item[:title] %>" data-detail="<%= item[:detail] %>" data-search="<%= item[:words] %>">
                <%= ui_icon_badge icon: item[:icon] %>
                <span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5"><span class="truncate text-sm font-semibold"><%= item[:title] %></span><span class="text-xs text-ink-3"><%= item[:meta] %></span></span>
                <%= heroicon "arrow-up-left", options: { class: "size-4 shrink-0 text-ink-3", "aria-hidden": true } %>
              </button>
            <% end %>
          </section>
        <% end %>
        <div class="px-5 py-10 text-center" data-blocks-search-target="empty" hidden>
          <p class="font-semibold">Nothing here just yet.</p><p class="pt-2 text-sm text-ink-3">Try a project, a person, or a different word.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</div>
```

app/javascript/controllers/blocks_search_controller.js

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"
import { registerDialog } from "helpers/dialog"
import { prefersReducedMotion } from "helpers/viewport"

export default class extends Controller {
  static targets = [
    "dialog",
    "trigger",
    "input",
    "bar",
    "results",
    "result",
    "group",
    "empty",
    "clear",
    "summary",
    "shortcut",
    "selectionTitle",
    "selectionDetail",
    "selectionStatus",
  ]

  connect() {
    this.animations = []
    this.onShortcut = (event) => {
      if (event.isComposing || !(event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) || event.key.toLowerCase() !== "k")
        return
      if (document.querySelector("dialog[open]") && !this.dialogTarget.open) return
      event.preventDefault()
      this.open()
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", this.onShortcut)
    this.shortcutTarget.textContent = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform) ? "⌘ K" : "Ctrl K"
  }

  disconnect() {
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", this.onShortcut)
    this.returnFocus = null
    this.reset()
  }

  open() {
    if (this.closing) return
    if (this.dialogTarget.open) return this.inputTarget.focus()
    this.returnFocus =
      document.activeElement === document.body ? this.triggerTarget : document.activeElement
    this.filter()
    this.dialogTarget.showModal()
    this.unregisterDialog = registerDialog(this.dialogTarget, { close: () => this.close() })
    this.inputTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    this.animate()
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.dialogTarget.open || this.closing) return
    this.closing = true
    this.animate({ reverse: true })
    Promise.allSettled(this.animations.map((animation) => animation.finished)).then(() =>
      this.reset(),
    )
  }

  reset() {
    this.animations.forEach((animation) => animation.cancel())
    this.animations = []
    this.dialogTarget.close()
    this.unregisterDialog?.()
    this.unregisterDialog = null
    this.closing = false
  }

  closed() {
    this.reset()
    this.returnFocus?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    this.returnFocus = null
  }

  dismiss(event) {
    if (event.target.hasAttribute("data-search-dismiss")) this.close()
  }

  clear() {
    this.inputTarget.value = ""
    this.filter()
    this.inputTarget.focus()
  }

  filter(event) {
    if (event?.isComposing) return
    const query = this.inputTarget.value.normalize("NFKC").trim().toLowerCase()
    const words = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    let count = 0
    for (const result of this.resultTargets) {
      result.hidden = !words.every((word) => result.dataset.search.includes(word))
      if (!result.hidden) count++
    }
    for (const group of this.groupTargets) {
      group.hidden = !group.querySelector("[data-blocks-search-target=result]:not([hidden])")
    }
    this.clearTarget.hidden = !this.inputTarget.value
    this.emptyTarget.hidden = count > 0
    this.summaryTarget.textContent = query
      ? `${count} ${count === 1 ? "result" : "results"} for “${this.inputTarget.value.trim()}”`
      : "Start with something recent"
  }

  navigate(event) {
    if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) return
    const results = this.resultTargets.filter((result) => !result.hidden)
    const items = [this.inputTarget, ...results]
    const index = items.indexOf(document.activeElement)
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault()
      const step = event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1
      items[Math.min(Math.max(index + step, 0), items.length - 1)].focus()
    } else if (event.key === "Enter" && document.activeElement === this.inputTarget) {
      event.preventDefault()
      results[0]?.click()
    }
  }

  select(event) {
    this.showSelection(event.currentTarget.dataset)
    this.close()
  }

  explore(event) {
    this.showSelection(event.currentTarget.dataset)
  }

  showSelection({ title, detail }) {
    this.selectionTitleTarget.textContent = title
    this.selectionDetailTarget.textContent = detail
    this.selectionStatusTarget.textContent = `Opened ${title}.`
  }

  animate({ reverse = false } = {}) {
    this.animations.forEach((animation) => animation.cancel())
    this.animations = []
    if (prefersReducedMotion()) return
    const from = this.triggerTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const to = this.barTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const insetY = Math.max((to.height - from.height) / 2, 0)
    const shiftY = from.top + from.height / 2 - (to.top + to.height / 2)
    const timing = {
      duration: reverse ? 200 : 360,
      easing: "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
      direction: reverse ? "reverse" : "normal",
      fill: "both",
    }
    this.animations = [
      this.barTarget.animate(
        [
          {
            clipPath: `inset(${insetY}px ${to.right - from.right}px ${insetY}px ${from.left - to.left}px round 999px)`,
            translate: `0 ${shiftY}px`,
          },
          { clipPath: "inset(-1rem round 999px)", translate: "0 0" },
        ],
        timing,
      ),
      this.resultsTarget.animate(
        [
          { opacity: 0, translate: "0 -0.5rem" },
          { opacity: 1, translate: "0 0" },
        ],
        timing,
      ),
    ]
  }
}
```

## Advanced styles

Class helpers style custom markup; the application owns its behavior.
Glass surfaces use glass_class; tw merges utility classes. Read https://github.com/lostcoords/ui#advanced-style-composition.

- `icon_badge_class(size: :base, extra: nil)`
- `icon_medallion_class(size: :sm, tone: :accent, extra: nil)`
- `avatar_class(size: :base, ink: false, linked: false, extra: nil)`
- `avatar_stack_class(compact: false, extra: nil)`
- `avatar_stack_row_class(extra: nil)`
- `eyebrow_class(extra: nil)`
- `badge_class(tone: :neutral, extra: nil)`
- `status_pill_class(tone: :accent, extra: nil)`
